question: Alha and Udal, who gave stiff resistance to the enemy, belonged to which of the following Rajput States?
solution: The correct answer is __**Chandella**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Alha **and **Udal** were legendary generals in the **service of King Parmardi-deva **(also known as **Parmal**), who belonged to the **Chandela dynasty.** • Their bravery and resistance against enemies are celebrated in the **epic ballad Alha-Khand**. • They were** born to Chandravanshiya Kshatriya family**. Udal was 12 years younger than Alha. • They learned the art of war and religious knowledge from **their guru, Gorakhnath**. • Alha and Udal were the learned scholars who shared a long-lasting bond between them. They were known for their bravery, serving their religion and love for their motherland.
